description:
The largest urban park in the city, and a cycling paradise with winding paths, lush greenery and open meadows connecting to Ocean Beach. See it all at ease on an electric bike. 

Riding through Golden Gate Park is a scenic and refreshing experience, with lush greenery, towering trees, and open meadows lining the winding paths. Cyclists pass by iconic landmarks like the de Young Museum, the Conservatory of Flowers, and Stow Lake, where ducks and paddle boats drift peacefully. The cool ocean breeze picks up as the ride approaches Ocean Beach, offering a stunning view of the Pacific. Whether for exercise or leisure, a bike ride through this urban oasis is a perfect way to enjoy nature in the heart of San Francisco.

Departs daily from 288 Beach Street, San Francisco CA 94133
The morning tour departure time is at 10am, return by 1:00pm.
The afternoon tour departure time is at 2pm, return by 5:00pm
